# Seetal

A Swiss-style delivery written for netex2gtfs's tests: a shared document (an
operator, a line, destination displays, stop points with positions and no stop
places, an availability condition) and a timetable document whose train states
its calls, names its operator and its train number, passes one stop and
arrives after midnight. Places, lines and times are invented; licensed as the
crate is (MIT OR Apache-2.0).
